name: doop
description: Visual intelligence pyramid for frontend UI/UX. 4 tiers: /doop:lint (instant CSS analysis, no browser), /doop:score (5s visual score card), /doop:fix (30s quick fix), /doop (full iteration loop). AI can code your UI, but it can't see it — doop gives Claude eyes. Scores against 5 anti-slop criteria. 2 loop modes: Polish (refine within tokens) and Redesign (bold transformation). Auto-discovers companion design skills. Platform-agnostic.
